role.en: Formerly SVP & Head Scientist, Amazon AGI
role.zh: 前 Amazon AGI 高级副总裁兼首席科学家

why.en: Came from Alexa chief scientist to run Amazon's AGI organisation, the Nova model family and the Trainium roadmap. Amazon consolidated that work under a different executive at the end of 2025.
why.zh: 从 Alexa 首席科学家出身，统管亚马逊 AGI 部门、Nova 系列模型与 Trainium 芯片路线。2025 年底亚马逊将这部分工作整合到另一位高管麾下。

title.en: Amazon Nova model family — technical overview
title.zh: Amazon Nova 模型家族技术总览

note.en: The line he built before Amazon consolidated AGI work elsewhere.
note.zh: 在亚马逊将 AGI 工作整合到别处之前，他建立的产品线。

title.en: As I close an incredible chapter at Amazon, I'm deeply grateful for the journey and people who made it so meaningful. I joined Amazon 12 years ago to work on Al
title.zh: As I close an incredible chapter at Amazon, I'm deeply grateful for the journey and people who made it so meaningful. I joined Amazon 12 years ago to work on Al

note.en: Farewell post announcing he is leaving Amazon after 12 years, ending his run leading Alexa AI and the Amazon AGI organization.
note.zh: 发文告别,宣布在亚马逊工作12年后离职,结束他执掌Alexa AI与亚马逊AGI团队的时期。

title.en: Since launching Amazon Nova Forge, we’ve had great conversations with the community about what it can do and why we built it. I explore the technical challenges
title.zh: Since launching Amazon Nova Forge, we’ve had great conversations with the community about what it can do and why we built it. I explore the technical challenges

note.en: Discusses the technical challenges behind Amazon Nova Forge, the team's open-training toolkit, following its launch.
note.zh: 介绍亚马逊Nova Forge开放训练工具背后的技术挑战,该工具发布后引发社区讨论。

title.en: Following the success of the Amazon Nova Act SDK, I’m thrilled to share that Nova Act is now available as a service on AWS for building and managing highly reli
title.zh: Following the success of the Amazon Nova Act SDK, I’m thrilled to share that Nova Act is now available as a service on AWS for building and managing highly reli

note.en: Announces Nova Act, Amazon's browser-automation agent SDK, is now generally available as a managed AWS service for building reliable AI agents at scale.
note.zh: 宣布亚马逊的浏览器自动化智能体SDK Nova Act现已作为AWS托管服务全面开放,用于大规模构建可靠的AI代理。

title.en: We've been hard at work solving a persistent industry problem: frontier models launch with impressive benchmarks, organizations test them, then they don't work
title.zh: We've been hard at work solving a persistent industry problem: frontier models launch with impressive benchmarks, organizations test them, then they don't work

note.en: Introduces a new Amazon effort targeting the gap between frontier model benchmark scores and real-world reliability for organizations deploying them.
note.zh: 介绍亚马逊针对前沿模型基准分数与实际部署可靠性之间落差所推出的新方案。

title.en: Security researchers are critical partners in building safer AI, pushing our systems in new ways to uncover vulnerabilities and edge cases that make our models
title.zh: Security researchers are critical partners in building safer AI, pushing our systems in new ways to uncover vulnerabilities and edge cases that make our models

note.en: Announces a new program partnering with security researchers to red-team Amazon's AI systems and surface vulnerabilities.
note.zh: 宣布与安全研究人员合作的新计划,对亚马逊AI系统进行红队测试以发现漏洞。

title.en: Amazon Nova Web Grounding is now generally available – a turnkey RAG solution that helps developers build more accurate AI applications with cited sources. No c
title.zh: Amazon Nova Web Grounding is now generally available – a turnkey RAG solution that helps developers build more accurate AI applications with cited sources. No c

note.en: Announces general availability of Amazon Nova Web Grounding, a turnkey RAG tool for building AI applications with cited web sources.
note.zh: 宣布亚马逊Nova Web Grounding正式上线,这是一款可为AI应用提供带引用网络来源的开箱即用RAG工具。

title.en: Year 2 of the Amazon Nova AI Challenge is here, focused on trusted software agents. 10 university teams will advance agentic AI for software eng, balancing capa
title.zh: Year 2 of the Amazon Nova AI Challenge is here, focused on trusted software agents. 10 university teams will advance agentic AI for software eng, balancing capa

note.en: Launches Year 2 of the Amazon Nova AI Challenge, expanding to 10 university teams building trusted, agentic software-engineering AI.
note.zh: 启动第二届亚马逊Nova AI Challenge,扩大到10支高校团队,致力于打造可信的智能体软件工程AI。

title.en: Excited to announce @amazon's new AI PhD Fellowship Program supporting 100+ students across 9 universities like Carnegie Mellon, MIT & Stanford. Fellows will be
title.zh: Excited to announce @amazon's new AI PhD Fellowship Program supporting 100+ students across 9 universities like Carnegie Mellon, MIT & Stanford. Fellows will be

note.en: Announces Amazon's new AI PhD Fellowship Program, funding 100+ students across nine universities including CMU, MIT and Stanford.
note.zh: 宣布亚马逊新的AI博士奖学金项目,资助包括卡内基梅隆、麻省理工和斯坦福在内的九所高校100多名学生。

title.en: Last week @AmazonAds launched Creative Studio – an agentic AI tool powered by Amazon Nova that works as a creative partner. Advertisers chat naturally with the
title.zh: Last week @AmazonAds launched Creative Studio – an agentic AI tool powered by Amazon Nova that works as a creative partner. Advertisers chat naturally with the

note.en: Highlights Amazon Ads' Creative Studio, an agentic ad-creation tool built on Nova models, as a real-world deployment of his team's work.
note.zh: 介绍基于Nova模型打造的亚马逊广告Creative Studio智能体工具,展示其团队技术的实际落地应用。

title.en: Proud of our team's work on D-REX! We’re addressing an important blind spot in AI safety – deceptive reasoning that hides behind seemingly benign responses. Thi
title.zh: Proud of our team's work on D-REX! We’re addressing an important blind spot in AI safety – deceptive reasoning that hides behind seemingly benign responses. Thi

note.en: Announces D-REX, a new AI safety research benchmark from his team targeting deceptive reasoning hidden behind seemingly benign model responses.
note.zh: 宣布团队推出的AI安全研究基准D-REX,用于检测隐藏在看似无害回答背后的欺骗性推理。

title.en: We heard your feedback that velocity is a major hurdle in AI agent development. Our new Nova Act extension tackles this head-on by eliminating constant context
title.zh: We heard your feedback that velocity is a major hurdle in AI agent development. Our new Nova Act extension tackles this head-on by eliminating constant context

note.en: Launches a Nova Act browser extension aimed at eliminating constant context-switching for developers building AI agents.
note.zh: 推出Nova Act浏览器扩展,旨在减少开发者构建AI代理时反复切换上下文的负担。

title.en: Check out today’s Decoder with @jluan on how our AGI Lab is building truly useful and highly reliable AI agents. Like people, agents don’t just learn by watchin
title.zh: Check out today’s Decoder with @jluan on how our AGI Lab is building truly useful and highly reliable AI agents. Like people, agents don’t just learn by watchin

note.en: Points to his appearance on The Verge's Decoder podcast discussing how Amazon's AGI Lab builds reliable agents by having them learn through doing, not just observation.
note.zh: 分享他在The Verge播客Decoder中的访谈,谈亚马逊AGI Lab如何通过让智能体“边做边学”而非仅靠观察来打造可靠的AI代理。

title.en: Recently showed how Nova Act is helping Alvee Health streamline the notoriously complex process of applying for public benefits like food assistance - they expe
title.zh: Recently showed how Nova Act is helping Alvee Health streamline the notoriously complex process of applying for public benefits like food assistance - they expe

note.en: Cites Nova Act helping Alvee Health streamline public-benefits applications, with an expected 30% increase in enrollments — a concrete real-world result for the agent SDK.
note.zh: 介绍Nova Act如何帮助Alvee Health简化公共福利申请流程,预计可使注册人数提升30%,是该智能体SDK的具体落地成果。

title.en: Exciting news on Nova Act: our SDK has seen breakthrough success achieving over 90% end-to-end task completion on early enterprise use cases. By incorporating n
title.zh: Exciting news on Nova Act: our SDK has seen breakthrough success achieving over 90% end-to-end task completion on early enterprise use cases. By incorporating n

note.en: Reports the Nova Act SDK achieving over 90% end-to-end task completion on early enterprise use cases, a concrete performance milestone.
note.zh: 报告Nova Act SDK在早期企业用例中实现超过90%的端到端任务完成率,是一个具体的性能里程碑。

title.en: Just launched virtual try-on in Amazon Nova Canvas! This gives retailers a powerful way to help shoppers see products as they’d really look – from trying on dif
title.zh: Just launched virtual try-on in Amazon Nova Canvas! This gives retailers a powerful way to help shoppers see products as they’d really look – from trying on dif

note.en: Launches virtual try-on in Amazon Nova Canvas, letting retailers show shoppers how products would look on them.
note.zh: 在亚马逊Nova Canvas中推出虚拟试穿功能,让零售商向购物者展示产品的实际穿着效果。

title.en: Amazon Nova Premier is now available on Bedrock! It excels at complex tasks like executing multi-step agentic workflows, and has a 1M token context window for p
title.zh: Amazon Nova Premier is now available on Bedrock! It excels at complex tasks like executing multi-step agentic workflows, and has a 1M token context window for p

note.en: Announces Amazon Nova Premier's availability on Bedrock, with a 1M-token context window for complex multi-step agentic workflows.
note.zh: 宣布亚马逊Nova Premier登陆Bedrock平台,拥有100万token上下文窗口,可支持复杂的多步骤智能体工作流。

title.en: We've heard your feedback and removed the login for Amazon Nova models. Just head to https://t.co/a4nvVJXKqJ. Some features like session history, uploads, and h
title.zh: We've heard your feedback and removed the login for Amazon Nova models. Just head to https://t.co/a4nvVJXKqJ. Some features like session history, uploads, and h

note.en: Announces Amazon removed the login requirement to try Nova models, lowering the barrier for developers to explore them.
note.zh: 宣布亚马逊取消了试用Nova模型的登录要求,降低了开发者尝试使用的门槛。

title.en: Nova Sonic is now live on https://t.co/a4nvVJXKqJ – the easiest way to explore our new speech-to-speech model, before implementing and scaling new apps on Amazo
title.zh: Nova Sonic is now live on https://t.co/a4nvVJXKqJ – the easiest way to explore our new speech-to-speech model, before implementing and scaling new apps on Amazo

note.en: Announces Nova Sonic, Amazon's speech-to-speech model, is now live for developers to try before building on Bedrock.
note.zh: 宣布亚马逊语音到语音模型Nova Sonic现已上线,供开发者在Bedrock上构建应用前先行体验。

title.en: Capping off a big week: Amazon Nova was named @NABShow's AI/ML Product of the Year and a @TVBEurope Best of Show winner. Great work by the team – excited to tak
title.zh: Capping off a big week: Amazon Nova was named @NABShow's AI/ML Product of the Year and a @TVBEurope Best of Show winner. Great work by the team – excited to tak

note.en: Notes Amazon Nova won NAB Show's AI/ML Product of the Year and a TVB Europe Best of Show award.
note.zh: 宣布亚马逊Nova荣获NAB Show年度AI/ML产品奖及TVB Europe最佳展示奖。

title.en: Excited to introduce a new addition to the Amazon Nova family – Nova Sonic – a speech-to-speech model that makes it easier for developers to build voice-powered
title.zh: Excited to introduce a new addition to the Amazon Nova family – Nova Sonic – a speech-to-speech model that makes it easier for developers to build voice-powered

note.en: Introduces Nova Sonic, a new speech-to-speech model added to the Amazon Nova family for building voice-powered apps and agents.
note.zh: 推出Nova Sonic,这是亚马逊Nova系列新增的语音到语音模型,用于构建语音驱动的应用与智能体。

title.en: Amazon Nova Reel 1.1 is now available in Amazon Bedrock, making multi-shot videos up to 2 mins! You can automate with one prompt or craft each shot. Here’s a da
title.zh: Amazon Nova Reel 1.1 is now available in Amazon Bedrock, making multi-shot videos up to 2 mins! You can automate with one prompt or craft each shot. Here’s a da

note.en: Launches Nova Reel 1.1 in Amazon Bedrock, enabling multi-shot videos up to two minutes long from a single prompt or shot-by-shot direction.
note.zh: 在亚马逊Bedrock中推出Nova Reel 1.1,可通过单一提示词或逐镜头指导生成长达两分钟的多镜头视频。

title.en: Big news: we've made #AmazonNova available through https://t.co/a4nvVJXKqJ, a new website to explore our foundation models. Plus, developers can download the al
title.zh: Big news: we've made #AmazonNova available through https://t.co/a4nvVJXKqJ, a new website to explore our foundation models. Plus, developers can download the al

note.en: Announces Amazon Nova foundation models are now available through a dedicated website, alongside the new Nova Act SDK research preview.
note.zh: 宣布亚马逊Nova基础模型现已通过专属网站开放,并同步推出Nova Act SDK研究预览版。

title.en: The Amazon Nova Family of Models: Technical Report and Model Card
title.zh: The Amazon Nova Family of Models: Technical Report and Model Card

note.en: The technical report and model card for the Amazon Nova foundation models, published under the collective byline of the Amazon AGI organisation he led as head scientist.
note.zh: 亚马逊 Nova 基础模型的技术报告与模型卡，由他担任首席科学家所领导的 Amazon AGI 团队以集体署名发表。

title.en: Rohit Prasad: Amazon Alexa and Conversational AI
title.zh: Rohit Prasad: Amazon Alexa and Conversational AI

note.en: A long-form interview on the Lex Fridman Podcast in which he explains how Alexa was built and where conversational AI was heading, recorded while he was head scientist of Alexa.
note.zh: 他在 Lex Fridman 播客中的长篇访谈，讲述 Alexa 的构建过程以及对话式人工智能的发展方向，录制时他任 Alexa 首席科学家。

title.en: Advancing the State of the Art in Open Domain Dialog Systems through the Alexa Prize
title.zh: Advancing the State of the Art in Open Domain Dialog Systems through the Alexa Prize

note.en: A paper he co-authored reporting what the second Alexa Prize competition taught Amazon about building open-domain dialog systems that keep users talking.
note.zh: 他参与合著的论文，总结第二届 Alexa Prize 竞赛让亚马逊学到的经验：如何构建能让用户持续对话的开放域对话系统。

title.en: On Evaluating and Comparing Open Domain Dialog Systems
title.zh: On Evaluating and Comparing Open Domain Dialog Systems

note.en: A paper he co-authored proposing how to evaluate and compare open-domain dialog systems, a measurement problem the Alexa Prize forced his team to solve.
note.zh: 他参与合著的论文，提出评估与比较开放域对话系统的方法——这正是 Alexa Prize 迫使其团队解决的度量难题。

title.en: Conversational AI: The Science Behind the Alexa Prize
title.zh: Conversational AI: The Science Behind the Alexa Prize

note.en: The paper laying out the science behind the Alexa Prize, with him as second author alongside Ashwin Ram, describing the competition Amazon ran to advance conversational AI.
note.zh: 阐述 Alexa Prize 背后科学原理的论文，他与 Ashwin Ram 并列为前两位作者，介绍亚马逊为推动对话式人工智能而举办的这项竞赛。

title.en: ALX306: State of the Union: Amazon Alexa and Recent Advances in Conversational AI
title.zh: ALX306: State of the Union: Amazon Alexa and Recent Advances in Conversational AI

note.en: Prasad delivers Alexa's State of the Union at AWS re:Invent, covering recent advances in conversational AI.
note.zh: Prasad在AWS re:Invent大会上发表Alexa年度状态报告，介绍对话式AI的最新进展。

title.en: Amazon announces his departure in a leadership shake-up
title.zh: 亚马逊在领导层调整中宣布其离职

body.en: SVP Peter DeSantis consolidated the company's AGI work under his own leadership.
body.zh: 高级副总裁 Peter DeSantis 将公司 AGI 工作整合至自己麾下。

title.en: Rohit Prasad reflected on leaving Amazon after 12 years | ETIH EdTech News
title.zh: Rohit Prasad reflected on leaving Amazon after 12 years | ETIH EdTech News

body.en: Prasad speaks publicly about leaving Amazon after 12 years, confirming his exit from the AGI organisation he led.
body.zh: 普拉萨德公开谈及在亚马逊工作 12 年后离职，确认已离开他主导的 AGI 部门。
